scope: exact Stage-2 selected-rank calculations using the authenticated fixed-N71 k260 parent; no Stage-1 eigensolve

basis_rule.rank_order: specified order only affects storage; the Hermitian selected principal submatrix is exact for the rank set

cases.role: prespecified equal-cost control; first three Q1 prefix ranks
prespecified equal-cost control; deterministic six-rank spacing

tracking.reference: k260 endpoint eigenvectors with exact zero-padding embedding by selected Stage-1 ranks

reconstruction_gates.action: STOP before scientific interpretation if any reconstruction gate fails

metrics.effect: selected observable minus P observable; energy-derived effects are reported in MHz
metrics.signed_recovery_ratio: selected effect divided by full_Q1 effect, reported only when abs(full_Q1 effect) >= 0.1 MHz for energy-derived metrics
metrics.recovered_fraction: 1 - abs(selected effect - full_Q1 effect)/abs(full_Q1 effect), not clipped and descriptive only; omitted when abs(full_Q1 effect) < 0.1 MHz
metrics.accuracy_per_added_rank: (abs(P error versus k240) - abs(selected error versus k240))/number of added ranks; MHz per rank for carriers
metrics.worst_case_carrier_error: maximum absolute error versus k240 over all nine preregistered carriers
metrics.primary_worst_carrier_error: maximum absolute error versus k240 over f07, f08, f78
metrics.operator_accuracy: relative error versus k240 for every edge, pathway score, block Frobenius norm and ordered singular value
metrics.rank225_group_interaction: effect({223,225,230}) - effect({223,230}) - effect({225}); this combines interactions of 225 with the pair and any three-way term

diagnostic_decision_rules.dominant_three_recovery_target: at least 0.80 recovered fraction for state7, state8, f07, f08 and f78; this is descriptive evidence, not convergence
diagnostic_decision_rules.operator_accuracy_PASS: every edge and operator-block scalar strict PASS and every pathway score strict PASS versus k240
diagnostic_decision_rules.operator_accuracy_BORDERLINE: no operator/path component strict FAIL but at least one strict BORDERLINE
diagnostic_decision_rules.strategy_PROMISING: dominant3 passes its recovery target, tracking gates, operator PASS, f07/f08 errors <=5 MHz and f78 error <=1 MHz versus k240, and beats both three-rank controls on primary worst carrier error and mean absolute state7/8 energy error
diagnostic_decision_rules.strategy_INCONCLUSIVE: tracking is safe, operator accuracy is not FAIL, and every primary recovery is at least 0.50, but PROMISING is not met
diagnostic_decision_rules.strategy_NOT_JUSTIFIED: tracking is unsafe, operator accuracy FAILS, or any primary recovery is below 0.50
diagnostic_decision_rules.formal_convergence: No selected-space result changes or satisfies the previously frozen retained-basis convergence verdict; same-parent agreement is not independent convergence evidence

scientific_guardrails: k260 is an endpoint, not ground truth
rank-attribution self-energy shares are not standalone addback predictions
selected spaces are exact principal-subspace Stage-2 calculations inside the same parent
no spatial/domain/n1max/N4, omitted-mode, physical-port, X90 or X180 validation follows
